title: message.taken
description: A message that was waiting (message.waiting) was answered, on this call — or will never be: `call` is null when it outlived WhatsApp's customer-service window and nothing may be said to it any more.

MessageTaken.description: One waiting message, off the queue.

message_id.description: The message, as message.waiting named it.

call.description: The call it was answered on; null when it expired unanswered.
